significance: A Ganesha temple below the Moti Dungri hill in Jaipur, built in 1761 and now visited by well over a hundred thousand devotees a year. It stands close to the city's Birla Mandir and is one of Jaipur's most popular shrines.
story: The sindoor-coloured image is held to be more than five hundred years old, brought from Gujarat to Udaipur and then carried to Jaipur in 1761.
